figs.name: namur-ne43-standard-loop-fail-mode-diagram
figs.alt: NAMUR NE43 loop diagram with smart transmitter fail modes and DCS fault actions
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing a NAMUR NE43 loop where a smart transmitter drives 21 mA or 3.6 mA on a fault and the PLC or DCS raises alarms.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>NAMUR NE43 loop from smart transmitter to PLC or DCS analog input with fault actions</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">NAMUR NE43 in a 4 to 20 mA Loop</text>
<rect x="30" y="90" width="150" height="90" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="105.0" y="117.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sensor</text>
<text x="105.0" y="140.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">pressure, flow</text>
<text x="105.0" y="163.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">or level</text>
<line x1="182" y1="135" x2="222" y2="135" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="225" y="80" width="230" height="110" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="340.0" y="117.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Smart transmitter</text>
<text x="340.0" y="141.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">self diagnostics</text>
<text x="340.0" y="165.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">detects faults</text>
<rect x="560" y="80" width="210" height="110" rx="10" fill="#eef6ff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="665.0" y="117.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PLC or DCS</text>
<text x="665.0" y="141.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">analog input</text>
<text x="665.0" y="165.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">reads 0 to 22 mA</text>
<line x1="455" y1="110" x2="560" y2="110" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="3"/>
<line x1="455" y1="160" x2="560" y2="160" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="3"/>
<line x1="500" y1="110" x2="540" y2="110" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="540" y1="160" x2="500" y2="160" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="507" y="96" font-size="17" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">loop</text>
<text x="507" y="185" font-size="17" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">current</text>
<text x="225" y="234" font-size="18" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Fail mode on a hardware fault</text>
<rect x="225" y="245" width="110" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="280.0" y="274.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Upscale</text>
<text x="280.0" y="298.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">21 mA</text>
<rect x="340" y="245" width="105" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="392.5" y="274.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Downscale</text>
<text x="392.5" y="298.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">3.6 mA</text>
<line x1="340" y1="190" x2="340" y2="214" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/>
<rect x="30" y="340" width="360" height="110" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210.0" y="377.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2 wire transmitter: use upscale</text>
<text x="210.0" y="400.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Loop powered device needs a</text>
<text x="210.0" y="423.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">minimum current to operate</text>
<rect x="30" y="460" width="360" height="46" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210.0" y="488.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4 wire transmitter: either mode works</text>
<line x1="665" y1="192" x2="665" y2="240" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="665" y="262" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">On a confirmed fault</text>
<rect x="475" y="280" width="300" height="60" rx="10" fill="#eef6ff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="625.0" y="315.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Trigger alarm, call maintenance</text>
<rect x="475" y="352" width="300" height="60" rx="10" fill="#eef6ff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="625.0" y="387.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Switch loop to manual mode</text>
<rect x="475" y="424" width="300" height="60" rx="10" fill="#eef6ff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="625.0" y="459.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Adjust or stop production</text>
</svg>

figs.name: namur-ne43-standard-dcs-interpretation-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart showing how a PLC or DCS sorts NAMUR NE43 normal, saturation and fault signals
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the NAMUR NE43 decision logic in a PLC or DCS: normal range, saturation, undefined zones and a fault confirmed after 4 seconds and two scans.
figs.after_h2: Interpretation by PLC and DCS Systems

<line x1="240" y1="450" x2="200" y2="450" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="220" y="437" font-size="18" fill="#b45309" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="20" y="405" width="178" height="90" rx="10" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>

<rect x="220" y="522" width="360" height="64" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="548.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Undefined zone</text>

figs.name: namur-ne43-standard-signal-zones-infographic
figs.alt: NAMUR NE43 standard signal zones chart for 4 to 20 mA normal, saturation and fault levels
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the NAMUR NE43 current zones: fault at 3.6 mA or below, saturation to 3.8 and 20.5 mA, normal 4 to 20 mA and fault at 21 mA.
figs.after_h2: Signal Zones Defined by NAMUR NE43
